relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, gain {strength} Strength.
relics.flavor: A giant died to make this. It is still furious about it.

relics.name: Radiant Aegis
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, if you have Block: gain {block} Block.
relics.flavor: It rewards the guarded. It has nothing to say to the reckless.

relics.name: Flayer's Censer
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, apply {crimsonBlight} Crimson Blight to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor: The smoke seeks out lungs. It is not particular about whose.

relics.name: Vigilant Halo
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, heal {heal} HP.
relics.flavor: It hovers a hand above your head, waiting for you to earn it.

relics.name: Carrion Talon
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, deal {damage} damage to a random enemy.
relics.flavor: The flock does not mourn. The flock moves to the next warm thing.

relics.name: Ember Idol
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor: It has been warm to the touch for a thousand years. It is patient about it.

relics.name: Crown of Stitches
relics.textTemplate: Begin each combat with {strength} Strength — and {frail} Frail. New limbs are heavy.
relics.flavor: It fits. That is the worst part.

relics.name: Warden Horn
relics.textTemplate: Draw {draw} extra card each turn. At the start of each combat, lose {loseHp} HP.
relics.flavor: It sounds without being blown. Something is answering.

relics.name: Ash of Remembrance
relics.textTemplate: Gain {gainEnergy} extra Energy each turn. At the start of each combat, gain {madness} Madness.
relics.flavor: The dead lend strength. They are not gentle about it.

relics.name: Cinder of the Fallen
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {gainEnergy} Energy. At the start of each combat, gain {madness} Madness.
relics.flavor: It pays out in the coin of endings. It expects you to make more of them.

relics.name: Crimson Covenant
relics.textTemplate: Your attacks apply {bleed} Bleed. At the start of each combat, lose {loseHp} HP.
relics.flavor: The pact is simple: your blood answers for theirs. It is not a fair trade, but it is fast.

relics.name: Traveler's Whetstone
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
relics.flavor: It was sharpened by hands that are no longer here to use it.

relics.name: Moonlit Vial
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, gain {block} Block.
relics.flavor: It never empties. It never fills, either.

relics.name: Warden's Lantern
relics.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw {draw} card.
relics.flavor: The flame gutters when you are hurt, then burns a little brighter.

relics.name: Salted Relic
relics.textTemplate: Gain 20% more Cinders from combats.
relics.flavor: It was buried to keep something in, or something out. No one remembers which.

relics.name: Hollowed Horn
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor: It sounds only once. Everything still standing flinches.

relics.name: Gilded Tear
relics.textTemplate: On your first turn each combat, heal {heal} HP.
relics.flavor: A single drop, hardened gold, wept for someone who never asked for it.

relics.name: Watchman's Badge
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, if you are not Weak: gain {strength} Strength.
relics.flavor: It is pinned to a coat that has seen more watches than the man wearing it.

relics.name: Howling Standard
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, gain {strength} Strength.
relics.flavor: It has not fallen in a hundred routs. It does not intend to start with yours.

relics.name: Emberwick Charm
relics.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {gainEnergy} Energy.
relics.flavor: It burns brightest at the moment you can least afford to slow down.

relics.name: Carrion Morsel
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, heal {heal} HP.
relics.flavor: The spire feeds those who feed it. It is not fussy about the manners of the exchange.

relics.name: Gravetender's Bell
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, draw {draw} card.
relics.flavor: One toll for each name laid down. The tending is in the counting.

relics.name: Sentinel's Oath
relics.textTemplate: Every 12th card you play each combat: gain {strength} Strength.
relics.flavor: The oath is long and the watch is longer. Endurance is its own kind of edge.

relics.name: Forsaken Warflag
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, apply {weak} Weak to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor: The colors are all but rotted away. What it musters now answers to no banner but yours.

relics.name: Wrath Coil
relics.textTemplate: Whenever you lose HP, deal {damage} damage to a random enemy.
relics.flavor: It winds tighter with every wound and lets go all at once, at someone else.

statuses.name: Strength
statuses.tooltip: Attacks deal +1 damage per stack.

statuses.name: Dexterity
statuses.tooltip: Cards grant +1 Block per stack.

statuses.name: Weak
statuses.tooltip: Deals 25% less attack damage. 1 stack expires each turn.

statuses.name: Vulnerable
statuses.tooltip: Takes 50% more attack damage. 1 stack expires each turn.

statuses.name: Frail
statuses.tooltip: Gains 25% less Block from cards. 1 stack expires each turn.

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.tooltip: Build-up: points do not decay. At {proc.threshold}, burst for {proc.burstPercent}% of max HP (min {proc.burstMin}, max {proc.burstMax}), ignoring Block, plus {proc.poiseDamage} Poise damage — then the build-up resets to zero. Fleshy targets briefly resist further Bleed after a burst.

statuses.name: Frost
statuses.tooltip: Build-up: points do not decay. At {proc.threshold}, burst for {proc.burstPercent}% of max HP (min {proc.burstMin}, max {proc.burstMax}), ignoring Block, and the target is left Weak and Frost-Exposed — then the build-up resets to zero.

statuses.name: Insanity
statuses.tooltip: Build-up: points do not decay. At {proc.threshold}, burst for {proc.burstPercent}% of max HP (min {proc.burstMin}, max {proc.burstMax}), ignoring Block, with {proc.poiseDamage} Poise damage and a guaranteed Stagger — then the build-up resets to zero.

statuses.name: Clotted
statuses.tooltip: Just burst — hardened against Bleed: incoming build-up reduced {resists.percent}% for {decay.duration} turns.

statuses.name: Weathered
statuses.tooltip: Just burst — hardened against Frost: incoming build-up reduced {resists.percent}% for {decay.duration} turns.

statuses.name: Resolute
statuses.tooltip: Just burst — hardened against Insanity: incoming build-up reduced {resists.percent}% for {decay.duration} turns.

statuses.name: Frost-Exposed
statuses.tooltip: Takes {tv.pct}% more damage from starstone attacks. Stacks with Vulnerable. {decay.duration} turns.

statuses.name: Unraveled
statuses.tooltip: Takes {tv.pct}% more damage from ritual and blight attacks. Stacks with Vulnerable. {decay.duration} turns.

statuses.name: Crimson Blight
statuses.tooltip: At the start of its turn, loses HP equal to Blight stacks (ignores Block). Stacks do not tick down; the Blight expires entirely after 3 turns. Re-applying adds stacks and refreshes the duration.

statuses.name: Burn
statuses.tooltip: At the start of its turn, loses HP equal to Burn stacks (ignores Block). One stack burns out each turn.

statuses.name: Regen
statuses.tooltip: At the start of its turn, heals HP equal to Regen stacks. Lasts the whole fight.

statuses.name: Madness
statuses.tooltip: At the start of your turn: lose 2 HP per stack, gain 1 Energy per stack, then Madness clears.

statuses.name: Staggered
statuses.tooltip: Poise broken: skips its next turn and takes 50% more attack damage until the end of your next turn.

statuses.name: Rallying Standard
statuses.tooltip: At the start of your turn: gain 1 Strength and take 1 damage (per stack).

statuses.name: Rallying Standard+
statuses.tooltip: At the start of your turn: gain 1 Strength (per stack).

statuses.name: Unbreakable
statuses.tooltip: Block no longer expires at the start of your turn. Block is capped at 30.

statuses.name: Unbreakable+
statuses.tooltip: Block no longer expires at the start of your turn. Block is capped at 40.

statuses.name: Goreblood
statuses.tooltip: Poise thresholds no longer increase after filling.

statuses.name: Sanguine Pact
statuses.tooltip: Whenever Bleed bursts on an enemy, gain 2 Strength per stack.

statuses.name: Starstone Charge
statuses.tooltip: A spell was cast this turn: your next Starstone bonus is live. Fades at end of turn.

statuses.name: Stargazer
statuses.tooltip: At the start of your turn, gain Starstone Charge.

statuses.name: Astral Armor
statuses.tooltip: At the end of your turn, gain 4 Block per stack.

statuses.name: Constellation
statuses.tooltip: Whenever you gain Starstone Charge, deal 4 damage per stack to a random enemy.

statuses.name: Azure Coil
statuses.tooltip: Whenever you play a Skill, gain 2 Block per stack.

statuses.name: Waxing Moon
statuses.tooltip: At the start of your turn, apply 2 Vulnerable to ALL enemies per stack.

statuses.name: Moonlit Shield
statuses.tooltip: Whenever you gain Starstone Charge, gain 3 Block per stack.

statuses.name: Astromancer
statuses.tooltip: At the start of your turn, gain Starstone Charge and draw a card.

statuses.name: Thorn Halo
statuses.tooltip: At the start of your turn, apply 1 Crimson Blight per stack to ALL enemies.

statuses.name: Communion
statuses.tooltip: At the start of your turn, heal 3 HP per stack.

statuses.name: Life Tithe
statuses.tooltip: Whenever an enemy dies, heal 8 HP per stack.

statuses.name: Stigmata
statuses.tooltip: Whenever you lose HP, heal 2 HP per stack.

statuses.name: Zealotry
statuses.tooltip: Whenever you lose HP, deal 3 damage to a random enemy per stack.

statuses.name: Ember Tide
statuses.tooltip: Whenever you heal, gain 1 Strength per stack.

statuses.name: Harbinger of Blight
statuses.tooltip: Whenever you apply Crimson Blight to an enemy, heal 1 HP per stack.

statuses.name: Blood Unction
statuses.tooltip: Your attacks apply 2 extra Bleed per hit this turn.

statuses.name: Iron Vow
statuses.tooltip: Whenever you lose HP, gain 3 Block per stack.

statuses.name: Shieldwall Echo
statuses.tooltip: At the start of your next turn: gain 4 Block per stack.

statuses.name: Prepared
statuses.tooltip: Your next setup payoff is empowered. Expires at turn end.

statuses.name: Venom
statuses.tooltip: At turn start, lose HP equal to Venom. 1 stack expires each turn.

statuses.name: Afterimage
statuses.tooltip: Every third card played each combat grants 3 Block per stack.

statuses.name: Deadly Tempo
statuses.tooltip: At turn start, become Prepared and draw 1 card per stack.

statuses.name: Opportunist
statuses.tooltip: When an enemy staggers, become Prepared and draw 1 card per stack.

statuses.name: Envenom
statuses.tooltip: Your attacks apply 1 Venom per stack.

statuses.name: Glass Cannon
statuses.tooltip: Deal 25% more attack damage, and take 25% more.

statuses.name: Magic Vulnerable
statuses.tooltip: Magic-school HP damage is increased while this lasts. Arcane Exposure buildup is locked.

stances.name: Gorefire Stance
stances.tooltip: Your attacks apply 2 Bleed per hit. On entering: take 2 damage (ignores Block).

stances.name: Bulwark Stance
stances.tooltip: Whenever you play a Skill, gain 2 Block. On entering: gain 3 Block.

keywords.name: Exhaust
keywords.tooltip: Removed from your deck for the rest of this combat after being played.

keywords.name: Ethereal
keywords.tooltip: If this card is in your hand at the end of your turn, it Exhausts.

keywords.name: Innate
keywords.tooltip: Starts each combat on top of your draw pile.

keywords.name: Retain
keywords.tooltip: Not discarded at the end of your turn.

events.name: Goldbough Avatar
events.text: A hulking avatar kneels in a clearing, grown into the roots of a golden sapling. It does not attack. It holds out one massive hand, palm up, waiting.

choices.label: Offer a card (lose a random card, take 6 damage)
choices.resultText: The card crumbles to gold leaf in its palm. Its other hand closes around yours — the blessing is not gentle.

choices.label: Pray (heal 20% max HP, gain a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: Warmth knits your wounds shut. Something else follows you out of the clearing.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The hand stays open behind you for a long time.

events.name: Abandoned Merchant Cart
events.text: A trader’s cart lies tipped in the mud, one wheel still turning. Cinder-light glints from a split strongbox. The mud around it is churned with bootprints.

choices.label: Loot the strongbox (gain 75 cinders; the owners may object)
choices.resultText: You scoop the cinders from the mud. Behind you, someone clears their throat.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Not every gift is free. You keep walking.

events.name: Wayward Pilgrim
events.text: A pilgrim sits at the roadside, robes soaked through, cradling something wrapped in cloth. "Fifty cinders," she says, without looking up. "It was my sister’s. I can’t carry it further."

choices.label: Give 50 cinders (gain a random relic)
choices.resultText: She presses the bundle into your hands and walks into the rain without counting.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.resultText: She nods, as if she expected nothing else.

events.name: Bloodstained Altar
events.text: An altar of dark stone, its channels worn smooth by use. The instructions are carved plainly: the stone sharpens what is given to it, and it keeps a portion.

choices.label: Offer your blood (upgrade 2 random cards, lose 8% max HP)
choices.resultText: The channels drink. Two of your cards come back keener than any smith could make them.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The altar does not care. It has waited longer than you.

events.name: Wandering Physician
events.text: A physician in a rain-rotted coat unrolls his instruments without being asked. "I can cut something out of you," he says. "The procedure is not painless. Or I can simply patch you."

choices.label: The procedure (remove a random card, take 4 damage)
choices.resultText: He holds something up to the light, nods, and does not let you see it.

choices.label: The patch (heal 15% max HP)
choices.resultText: Competent, quick, and strangely cold. He refuses payment.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: "Suit yourself. The spire will finish what I would have started."

events.name: Golden Moth
events.text: A moth the size of a shield rests on a broken pillar, wings dusted with cinder-light. It is dying, slowly and without complaint. Cinders drip from its wings like pollen.

choices.label: Gather the falling cinders (gain 40 cinders)
choices.resultText: The cinders come away easily. The moth watches you with something like approval.

choices.label: Sit with it a while (heal 10% max HP)
choices.resultText: You keep the vigil. When you rise, some of its lightness has passed to you.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some deaths are not yours to attend.

events.name: Shrine of the Feral Ember
events.text: A shrine no church would recognize: antlers, wax, and old blood. Ember pools here anyway — wild, unattended, and guarded by something that has not left claw marks this fresh by accident.

choices.label: Take the offering (gain a random relic — its keeper objects)
choices.resultText: Your hand closes on the relic. Behind you, the undergrowth stands up.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Wild ember keeps its own accounts. You leave the ledger closed.

events.name: Ancient Cinder Stone
events.text: A standing stone hums with old script. Reading it makes your teeth ache and your hands steadier. It would also break beautifully.

choices.label: Study it (upgrade a random card, lose 7% max HP)
choices.resultText: The script rearranges something behind your eyes. You are sharper, and less.

choices.label: Smash it (gain 35 cinders)
choices.resultText: The stone comes apart into cinder-light. The hum does not entirely stop.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some doors are better left unread.

events.name: Grave of the Nameless
events.text: A cairn of broken swords marks a grave no one tends. Cinder-light seeps between the blades like frost. The mound is quiet — the particular quiet of something that could stop being quiet.

choices.label: Dig for cinders (gain 90 cinders; the keeper may wake)
choices.resultText: The cinders come loose in cold handfuls. Somewhere under the swords, something shifts its weight.

choices.label: Pay respects (heal 15% max HP)
choices.resultText: You right a fallen blade and stand a while. When you leave, you are lighter than you came.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the nameless to their naming.

events.name: Sleeping Smith
events.text: A smith slumps over his anvil, hammer still loose in one hand. His forge is cold, but the blade laid across it hums like it remembers heat. He does not stir when you approach.

choices.label: Take the blade (upgrade a random card)
choices.resultText: The hum quiets the moment it leaves the anvil, as if it was only ever waiting for a hand.

choices.label: Wake him (pay 30 cinders, heal 12% max HP)
choices.resultText: He blinks awake just long enough to press a cold coin into your palm, and something in you settles.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You let him sleep. The blade goes on humming behind you.

events.name: Wyrm Trial
events.text: A cracked stone ring marks a trial-ground no map names. A single soldier stands within it, unmoving, waiting for someone foolish or hungry enough to step inside.

choices.label: Enter the ring (fight the soldier for 60 cinders)
choices.resultText: You step across the stone line. The soldier finally moves.

choices.label: Circle it instead (lose 5% max HP crossing the rubble, gain 20 cinders)
choices.resultText: The rubble takes its toll, but the ring — and whatever waits in it — stays quiet.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some rings are drawn for a reason. You leave this one closed.

events.name: Discarded Reliquary
events.text: A traveler's pack lies split open at the trail's edge, its owner nowhere to be found. Among the ruined provisions, a single card sits face-down, deliberately placed — as though left as a warning, not a gift.

choices.label: Take it with you (gain a Guilt curse; the pack has 45 cinders)
choices.resultText: You pick it up before you can think better of it. It settles into your deck like it was always there.

choices.label: Burn the pack (gain 25 cinders; leave the card)
choices.resultText: The provisions catch fast. The face-down card curls to ash before you can read it.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You step around the pack and do not look back.

events.name: Warden's Altar
events.text: An altar carved with a face too many-eyed to be a saint. A voice — or something like one — offers to lend you its strength, if you will let it watch through your eyes for the rest of the road.

choices.label: Accept its gaze (gain a random relic; take a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: The eyes close over yours like a second lid. You do not feel them leave.

choices.label: Shatter the altar (fight what wakes, gain 70 cinders)
choices.resultText: The stone face cracks down the middle. What answers the noise is not stone at all.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The many eyes stay open behind you, patient as ever.

events.name: Blight-Priest's Offer
events.text: A priest kneels in a ring of dead grass, robes fused to weeping skin. He is unbothered, almost radiant. "The Blight gives," he says, holding out a reliquary in one ruined hand. "It asks only a little flesh in return."

choices.label: Accept the blessing (gain a random relic; lose 10% max HP)
choices.resultText: His hand closes over yours. The reliquary is warm, and the warmth does not stop where your skin does.

choices.label: Rob him (gain 50 cinders; take a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: He does not resist. He only smiles wider, as if you have taken exactly what he meant you to.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: "The Blight is patient," he calls after you. "It will keep your seat."

events.name: Handspider Nest
events.text: A cluster of pale, many-jointed hands scuttles in the dark ahead, nested around a strongbox they have dragged from somewhere below. They have not noticed you. Yet.

choices.label: Snatch the strongbox (gain 80 cinders; they may wake)
choices.resultText: The box comes free with a wet scrape. All around you, fingers go still — then flex.

choices.label: Back away slowly
choices.resultText: You retrace your steps one careful footfall at a time. The nest never stirs.

events.name: Seat of Faded Emberlight
events.text: A guiding ember once pooled here, now guttering to a thread of gold. It has just enough left to give — a mending, or a sharpening — but not both, and not for long.

choices.label: Warm yourself (heal 18% max HP)
choices.resultText: The last of the light soaks into you. When it fades, the ground is only ground.

choices.label: Temper a blade (upgrade a random card, lose 6% max HP)
choices.resultText: You hold a card to the dying ember until it takes the edge. It costs you something to keep the flame that long.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You let the ember fade unspent. Some kindnesses are not yours to take.

events.name: Merchant's Ghost
events.text: A translucent figure keeps a stall that is no longer there, weighing wares no living hand can hold. "Custom," it sighs, almost grateful. "It has been so long. I have something you'll want."

choices.label: Pay in kind (give 60 cinders, gain a random relic)
choices.resultText: The cinders vanish from your hand into a ledger that isn't there. The relic is very solid, and very cold.

choices.label: Take it and run (gain a random relic and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: It does not chase you. It only watches, and writes something down, and the writing follows you out.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: "Come again," it says, to no one, already forgetting you.

events.name: Cinderbear Den
events.text: The cave reeks of musk and old kills. Cinder-light glitters in the bone-litter at the back — a fortune, if you are quiet, and quick, and the mound of fur by the wall keeps breathing slow.

choices.label: Go for the hoard (gain 100 cinders; it will almost certainly wake)
choices.resultText: Your hands fill with cold light. Behind you, the breathing stops.

choices.label: Skim the edges (squeeze past the rubble, lose 5% max HP, gain 25 cinders)
choices.resultText: You take only what is within reach and pay for it in scraped ribs. The den keeps its heart.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some fortunes are guarded by teeth. You leave this one to its keeper.

events.name: Stake of the Martyr
events.text: A stake of gilded thorn juts from the path, humming with the promise of return. It asks for a piece of you to hold in trust — a card, and a measure of your vigor — and offers a relic drawn up from where the dead wait.

choices.label: Give what it asks (remove a random card, lose 8% max HP, gain a random relic)
choices.resultText: The stake drinks a card and a breath of your strength, and hands back something older than either.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You step around the thorn. It hums after you, patient, certain you'll be back.

events.name: The Oracle's Riddle
events.text: A pair of enormous fingers rises from a font of still water, tapping a slow rhythm only they understand. Read one way, the rhythm sharpens the mind. Read another, it mends the flesh — but the second reading leaves a mark.

choices.label: Sharpen (upgrade 2 random cards, take 5 damage)
choices.resultText: The rhythm settles behind your eyes. Two of your cards come back keener; your hands ache with the knowing.

choices.label: Mend (heal 22% max HP, gain a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: Warmth floods you, generous and total. Something reads back through the water, and does not look away.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The fingers tap on. You leave the riddle unanswered, which is its own kind of answer.

events.name: The Keeper of the Nameless
events.text: A figure in grave-clothes waits at a fork in the road, a lantern of cinder-light held low. It knows the cairn of broken swords. It knows what you did there. It has been walking since.

choices.label: Return what you took (lose 90 cinders; the keeper stands down)
choices.resultText: The cinders go back into the lantern one by one. The keeper turns without a word and walks the way you came.

choices.label: Face the keeper (fight; keep what you took)
choices.resultText: The lantern goes out. Things that were following the keeper are not so patient.

choices.label: Accept the keeper's thanks (gain the Gravetender's Bell)
choices.resultText: A small bell, iron and cold, pressed into your palm. "One toll for each name," the keeper says. "You will know when."

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The keeper does not follow. It only needed to be seen.

events.name: The Nameless at Rest
events.text: The road ends at a second cairn, newer than the first — every sword standing, every name struck into the stone. The keeper is not here. Whatever it was walking toward, it arrived.

choices.label: Keep the vigil (upgrade 2 random cards)
choices.resultText: You stand until the cinder-light gutters. The bell in your pack rings once, though nothing moved it.

choices.label: Rest among the stones (heal 30% max HP)
choices.resultText: What you returned bought you this much: a night among the nameless, and no one waking you.

choices.label: Loot the barrow (gain 120 cinders, gain a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: Second time is easier. The names on the stone do not object. That is the part that follows you.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the cairn as you found it, which is more than the first one got.

flasks.name: Blight Coating
flasks.textTemplate: Apply 4 Crimson Blight to an enemy.

flasks.name: Blood Unction
flasks.textTemplate: This turn, your attacks apply 2 extra Bleed per hit.

flasks.name: Wondrous Draught
flasks.textTemplate: Gain the effects of two different random flasks at once.

classes.name: Reaver
classes.description: Fights up close and switches footing mid-battle — one stance hits harder, the other holds the line. Wounds you land keep bleeding, and heavy blows stagger.

classes.name: Starseer
classes.description: Casts in sequence — the second spell each turn strikes harder than the first. Fragile early on, so the order you play cards matters more than their power.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Sets up a clean opening, then turns speed, poison, and opportunism into decisive strikes before the enemy can recover.

classes.name: Herald
classes.description: Spends its own health to act, then heals it back. Spreads a rot that damages enemies over time. One pool for everything, so mistakes stack up fast.

armaments.name: Straight Sword
armaments.blurb: Honest steel. It asks nothing clever of you.

armaments.name: Greatsword
armaments.blurb: Slow, and it does not care.

armaments.name: Dagger
armaments.blurb: Two cuts where one would do.

armaments.name: Shortbow
armaments.blurb: A compact bow represented by a generic armament silhouette in this slice.

armaments.name: Katana
armaments.blurb: A long curve, and a long grudge.

armaments.name: Halberd
armaments.blurb: Reach enough to keep the dead at arm's length.

armaments.name: Warhammer
armaments.blurb: Poise is a fiction. This is the argument.

armaments.name: Twinblade
armaments.blurb: Both ends are the business end.

basicCardProfiles.flavor: A short iron answer when no main-hand weapon is ready.
Steel gives the motion its name.
Two precise openings in one breath.
Distance is presentation; the point still lands.
Ash carries a small cold light.
The sceptre answers in a darker tongue.
Nothing in your hands but the ground under your feet.
Turn the haft and weather the blow.
Meet the blow on carried iron.
A thin ward drawn through the focus.
A ward held together by rite.
The empty hand's art is not being there.
Let the weapon teach the hand.
Set the breath behind the focus.

tagDomains.label: Card
tagDomains.blurb: What a card IS — its school, form and feel. Carried by cards, by the classes that lean on them, and by the equipment that rewrites them.

tagDomains.label: Creature
tagDomains.blurb: What a creature IS. Gates proc resistance, and the one domain the engine reads at runtime.

tagDomains.label: Item
tagDomains.blurb: What a piece of gear DOES beyond its numbers, and what a run pickup is.

tagDomains.label: Run
tagDomains.blurb: Run structure — what an event, an encounter or an unlock is about.

tagDomains.label: Item type
tagDomains.blurb: What a piece of equipment IS, as the Armoury and the smith name it. Distinct from the card domain: a Blade item type and a Blade card school are different facts about the same sword.

tagDomains.label: Grant source
tagDomains.blurb: Where a starting card came from. The composed deck deals bound cards in this vocabulary's authored order, so adding a source is a row here rather than a code change. Nothing WEARS these — the `grant` family exists to declare them, the way `effect` declares which words a damage effect may carry.
